game_concept: A tower defense set in Sand Dunes – Scorpion Canyon, a canyon of scorpions: the desert nomad must handle mirage spirits while practicing debugging & combined skills. Core idea – Print Tracer: Insert print statements at the right lines to reveal what mirage spirits changed.
theme: Sand Dunes – Scorpion Canyon: a canyon of scorpions
core_gameplay_loop: In Scorpion Canyon, repeat each round: Insert print statements at the right lines to reveal what mirage spirits changed. Each round, mirage spirits strike the water well, so respond before the next strike lands. Then check the trace_clarity value and advance.
secondary_mechanics: Bonus coins for fast correct moves
player_objective: Protect the water well from mirage spirits in Scorpion Canyon: keep the trace_clarity meter above zero by applying the concept correctly until the 55-second timer ends.
controls: Code-editor: type or edit short lines in the code panel and press Run; click to select targets.
lose_condition: trace_clarity drops to 0, or lives reach 0, before the 55-second timer ends.
learning_alignment: Week 9 – Debugging & Combined Skills | Level 4 (applied tier): Print Tracer
assets_style: sun-baked pixel-art desert: golden dunes, tall cacti, a bright blue oasis, warm orange shadows; flat Kenney-style sprites; desert oud, hand drums and sandy wind
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Print Tracer' (Week 9 slot 4), mission type 'Survival Siege', and setting 'Scorpion Canyon'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Sand Dunes
region.mood: desert oud, hand drums and sandy wind

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how trace_clarity changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against mirage spirits in Scorpion Canyon.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Timer reaches 55 seconds while trace_clarity > 0.
